parameters.description: Sampling frequency of the `x` time series. Defaults to 1.0.
parameters.name: fs

parameters.description:
Desired window to use. If `window` is a string or tuple, it is
passed to `get_window` to generate the window values, which are
DFT-even by default. See `get_window` for a list of windows and
required parameters. If `window` is array_like it will be used
directly as the window and its length must be equal to the length
of the axis over which the periodogram is computed. Defaults
to 'boxcar'.
parameters.name: window
parameters.type_doc: str or tuple or array_like, optional

parameters.description:
Length of the FFT used. If `None` the length of `x` will be
used.
parameters.name: nfft

parameters.description:
Specifies how to detrend each segment. If `detrend` is a
string, it is passed as the `type` argument to the `detrend`
function. If it is a function, it takes a segment and returns a
detrended segment. If `detrend` is `False`, no detrending is
done. Defaults to 'constant'.
parameters.name: detrend

parameters.description:
If `True`, return a one-sided spectrum for real data. If
`False` return a two-sided spectrum. Defaults to `True`, but for
complex data, a two-sided spectrum is always returned.
parameters.name: return_onesided

parameters.description:
Selects between computing the power spectral density ('density')
where `Pxx` has units of V²/Hz and computing the squared magnitude
spectrum ('spectrum') where `Pxx` has units of V², if `x`
is measured in V and `fs` is measured in Hz. Defaults to
'density'
parameters.name: scaling

parameters.description:
Axis along which the periodogram is computed; the default is
over the last axis (i.e. ``axis=-1``).
parameters.name: axis

returns.description: Power spectral density or power spectrum of `x`.
returns.name: Pxx

signature: periodogram(x, fs=1.0, window='boxcar', nfft=None, detrend='constant', return_onesided=True, scaling='density', axis=-1)
summary: Estimate power spectral density using a periodogram.
